source_title: DGQA Technician (Skilled) & Technician (Semi Skilled) Recruitment 2026 – 32 Posts
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 32 · Posts: 2 designation(s) · Type: Regular Government Service · Mode: Offline · Fee: Not mentioned · Apply: Within 21 days of Employment News publication (approx. 7 November 2026) · Salary: Level-1 to Level-2 (₹18,000–₹63,200) · Selection: Written Test + Trade Test · Location: Kanpur, New Delhi, Shahjahanpur
The Directorate General of Quality Assurance (DGQA) under the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, invites offline applications for 32 Group ‘C’ Non-Ministerial Industrial posts. These comprise 11 Technician (Skilled) and 21 Technician (Semi-Skilled) vacancies under Advertisement No. CQA (GS)/2026/1 published in Employment News for 17–23 October 2026.
Applications are accepted by ordinary post or Speed Post to the Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores), Kanpur. Selected candidates join on two years’ probation and remain liable for posting anywhere in India, including field or remote areas.
Indian nationals holding the required ITI certificate (plus Matriculation and one year experience for Skilled posts) and willing to qualify the departmental Trade Skill Test may apply before the relative deadline linked to the Employment News publication date.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
Only one application is allowed. Multiple applications lead to summary rejection of all without reason.
Indicate the specific Trade and Station in the application. No change of post or posting station is permitted after submission.
Applications must reach by the closing date calculated from the Employment News publication (21 days for most candidates; 28 days for specified remote regions). Late applications are rejected.
Include a self-addressed envelope (30 cm × 12 cm) with a ₹60 postal stamp for the admit card. An incorrect address may prevent you from receiving the admit card.

Official application route: Offline by ordinary post or Speed Post to the Controller, Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores), Kanpur; no fee printed.
Official updates page: DGQA Official Website

Quick Overview – DGQA Technician (Skilled) & Technician (Semi Skilled) Recruitment 2026 – 32 Posts
Organisation: Directorate General of Quality Assurance (DGQA)
Recruitment / Exam Name: DGQA Technician (Skilled) & Technician (Semi-Skilled) Recruitment 2026
Notification / Advertisement No.: CQA (GS)/2026/1
Post(s): Technician (Skilled), Technician (Semi-Skilled)
Job Location: Kanpur (UP), New Delhi, Shahjahanpur (UP); liable for anywhere in India
Job Type / Nature: Regular Government Service – Group ‘C’ Non-Ministerial Industrial posts, initial appointment on probation for two years
Salary: Level-1 (₹18,000–₹56,900) to Level-2 (₹19,900–₹63,200)
Apply Between: From publication in Employment News to within 21 days (approx. 17 October 2026 to 7 November 2026)
Notification PDF: Download the matching advertisement from Employment News or the DGQA Official Website
What Posts Are Available? – Post-wise Vacancy & Eligibility
Technician (Semi Skilled) holds 21 of the 32 seats. Technician (Skilled) accounts for the remaining 11. Vacancies are distributed across Controllerate and Senior Quality Assurance Establishment units in Kanpur, New Delhi and Shahjahanpur.
Horizontal reservation applicable: ESM 10% and Agniveer 10% on both posts; PwBD 4% on Technician (Semi Skilled) only.
Who Is Eligible for DGQA 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: Only Indian Nationals need to apply.
Domicile / local condition: The notice does not state a domicile or residence condition in the clauses read.
Technician (Skilled): Matriculation (10th class pass) from a recognised Board or equivalent; ITI Pass Certificate in the specified trade (Computer Hardware and Networking, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Cutting & Sewing, Electrician, Fitter, Information Technology and Electronic System Maintenance, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist, Painter, Pattern Maker, Plumber, Refrigeration and Air conditioner Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker or Tools and Die (Jig and Fixture)) or its equivalent Defence Services Tradesman Course approved by Central or State Government; one year experience in the specified trade from a recognised Organisation or Undertaking; qualify departmental Trade Skill Test.
Technician (Semi Skilled): ITI Pass Certificate in the specified trade (Book Binder, Carpenter, Computer Hardware and Networking, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Cutting & Sewing, Electrician, Fitter, Information Technology and Electronic System Maintenance, Instrument Mechanic, Painter, Plumber, Refrigeration and Air Conditioner Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker or Tools and Die (Jig and Fixture)) or its equivalent Defence Services Tradesman Course; qualify departmental Trade Skill Test.
Qualification must be held by: Not separately printed beyond the requirement to possess the certificates and experience as stated.
What Is the Age Limit? (as on the closing date for receipt of applications)
✅ A 26-year-old UR candidate born on 7 November 2000 — eligible (as on approx. 7 November 2026 closing date).
❌ A 28-year-old UR candidate born on 7 November 1998 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check instantly.
Reservation: Vertical reservation as per category-wise table above. Horizontal reservation: ESM 10% and Agniveer 10% on both posts; PwBD 4% on Technician (Semi Skilled) only.
PwBD: 4% horizontal reservation on Technician (Semi Skilled). Age relaxation as per relevant DoP&T guidelines. Suitability per post is not further detailed beyond this.
What Is the Salary? – Pay Scale & Benefits
Technician (Semi Skilled): Pay Matrix Level-1 (₹18,000 to ₹56,900). Technician (Skilled): Pay Matrix Level-2 (₹19,900 to ₹63,200).
Recruited candidates draw salary according to the said pay level and are entitled to other applicable benefits and allowances. They are covered under the National Pension Scheme (NPS) / Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as per extant Government of India rules.
Benefits (as printed): Applicable benefits and allowances; NPS/UPS.
7th CPC Salary Calculator . This calculator gives an indicative estimate; the official method in the notification prevails.
Payment mode: Not applicable (no application fee printed).
Prepare the application on the prescribed format as per Appendix ‘A ’, typed in English on A4-size paper (Arial size 12, double-sided).
Indicate the specific Trade and Station. Attach two Admit Cards as per Appendix ‘B’, one self-addressed envelope (30 cm × 12 cm) with a ₹60 postal stamp, three recent passport-size photographs, and self-attested copies of required certificates.
Write “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TECHNICIAN (SKILLED)” or “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TECHNICIAN (SEMI SKILLED)” on the envelope.
Send it by ordinary post or Speed Post to the Controller, Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores), DGQA Stores Complex, Ashok Path, Meerpur Cantt, Kanpur-208004, Uttar Pradesh, so that it reaches by the closing date (within 21 days of Employment News publication).
Keep the postal receipt or tracking number.
Submitting more than one application (all will be rejected).
Failing to specify Trade and Station or attempting to change them later.
Omitting the self-addressed envelope with ₹60 stamp or writing an incorrect address.
Using correction fluid or overwriting on the form.
Applying without the required experience certificate (for Skilled posts) or Trade Skill Test qualification readiness.
डीजीक्यूए टेक्नीशियन (कुशल) और टेक्नीशियन (अर्ध-कुशल) भर्ती 2026 – 32 पद
डायरेक्टोरेट जनरल ऑफ क्वालिटी एश्योरेंस (DGQA) ने टेक्नीशियन (कुशल) के 11 और टेक्नीशियन (अर्ध-कुशल) के 21 पदों सहित कुल 32 ग्रुप ‘सी’ पदों के लिए आवेदन आमंत्रित किए हैं। विज्ञापन संख्या CQA (GS)/2026/1 रोजगार समाचार के 17–23 अक्टूबर 2026 अंक में प्रकाशित हुआ है।
अंतिम तिथि क्या है? रोजगार समाचार में प्रकाशन की तारीख से 21 दिन के भीतर (लगभग 7 नवंबर 2026)। दूरस्थ क्षेत्रों के लिए 28 दिन।
कैसे आवेदन करें? ऑफलाइन डाक द्वारा कंट्रोलर, कंट्रोलरेट ऑफ क्वालिटी एश्योरेंस (जनरल स्टोर्स), कानपुर को भेजें। आवेदन में ट्रेड और स्टेशन जरूर लिखें।
योग्यता क्या चाहिए? कुशल के लिए 10वीं + आईटीआई + 1 साल अनुभव + ट्रेड स्किल टेस्ट। अर्ध-कुशल के लिए आईटीआई + ट्रेड स्किल टेस्ट।
अधिक जानकारी के लिए आधिकारिक वेबसाइट dgqadefence.gov.in देखें।
Written Test (objective multiple-choice questions based on 10th standard syllabus).
Departmental Trade Skill Test in the applied trade.
Document verification and medical examination.
Shortlisting is based on Written Test marks and reservation category. Merit list is prepared post Written Test and Trade Test, trade-cum-station wise.
Tie-break (as printed): Older candidate by date of birth; higher marks in Numerical Aptitude; higher marks in English Language & Comprehension.
A daily Current Affairs digest helps with the General Awareness section.
Negative marking: Not mentioned in the notice.
The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Recruitment for You?
This is a regular Group ‘C’ technical recruitment under the Ministry of Defence with two years’ probation and all-India transfer liability. Pay follows 7th CPC Levels 1 and 2, with NPS/UPS coverage. Selection rests on a 100-mark written test (10th standard level) plus a qualifying Trade Skill Test.
Best fit: ITI holders in the listed trades with 1 year of relevant experience (for Skilled posts) who are ready for postings across India.
Who should skip: Candidates unwilling to serve in field or remote areas, or those who cannot produce the required experience certificate and clear the Trade Skill Test.
Practical tip: Type the application carefully on A4 paper exactly as per Appendix ‘A’, specify one Trade and one Station, and post early with the ₹60-stamped self-addressed envelope so the admit card reaches you.
What makes this recruitment different: Offline application only, relative deadline tied to Employment News publication, and mandatory Trade Skill Test after the written exam.
Application Form (Appendix ‘A’), two Admit Cards (Appendix ‘B’), self-addressed envelope (30 cm × 12 cm) with ₹60 stamp, three recent passport-size photographs, self-attested copies of Matriculation/ITI certificates, experience certificate (for Skilled), category certificates (if claiming reservation), Aadhaar, birth certificate, and signed instructions (Appendix ‘C’).

⚠️ Document Alert Specific to This Recruitment
Experience certificate must be from a recognised Organisation or undertaking for the specified trade (Skilled posts).
EWS/OBC/SC/ST certificates must be in the prescribed format from the competent authority listed in the notice.
Self-addressed envelope address must be accurate; no overwriting permitted.
What Are the Service Conditions? – Probation, Bond & Posting
Initial appointment on probation for a period of two years. Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere within the territorial limits of the Union of India, including field locations/remote areas, as and when required, as per extant Government of India rules. Covered under NPS/UPS. No bond amount is printed in the notice.
Provisional selection after Written Test and Trade Test.
Document verification and medical examination.
Appointment letter subject to government satisfaction on suitability and character antecedents.
✅ Confirmed: Two years’ probation; all-India posting liability; NPS/UPS. ❓ Not specified: Exact training details or confirmation timeline beyond probation.
Future instructions will appear on the official website.
Each candidate can submit only one application indicating a specific Trade & Station. Multiple applications result in the summary rejection of all. No change in post or posting station after submission, though DGQA may post anywhere in India. Candidature in reserved categories remains provisional until documents are verified. False information or incomplete applications lead to cancellation. No TA/DA is admissible. Recruitment may be cancelled or postponed without notice.
The advertisement does not print a recruitment helpline or email. Check the DGQA Official Website for updates.
⚠️ Contact details are from the official notification/website. Verify before contacting. Never pay money to anyone offering job assistance. Report fraud at cybercrime.gov.in.

FAQs – DGQA Technician (Skilled) & Technician (Semi Skilled) 2026
What is the last date to apply for DGQA Technician (Skilled) & Technician (Semi Skilled) 2026?
Within 21 days of publication in Employment News (approx. 7 November 2026). Specified remote regions have 28 days. No extension has been announced as of 18 October 2026.
What is the age limit for DGQA Technician (Semi Skilled)?
Minimum 18 years. Maximum 27 years for UR/EWS as on the closing date. Age is calculated as on the closing date for receipt of applications.
Is there an exam for DGQA Technician (Semi Skilled), or is it interview-based?
Written Test (100 objective questions) followed by departmental Trade Skill Test. No interview stage is mentioned in this notice. Negative marking is not mentioned.
What is the salary for Technician (Semi Skilled) posts in this recruitment?
Level-1 (₹18,000 to ₹56,900) as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix, plus applicable allowances. Covered under NPS/UPS.
Can final-year students apply for this recruitment?
Not mentioned in the notification. Candidates must possess the required ITI certificate (and experience for Skilled posts) as stated.
Is this Technician (Semi Skilled) post a permanent government job?
Advertised as a regular Group ‘C’ post; appointments are made on probation for two years and confirmed under the service rules.
Yes. The notice does not state a domicile or residence condition in the clauses read. Indian nationals may apply.
Where will selected candidates be posted?
Initially at Kanpur, New Delhi or Shahjahanpur as indicated in the application, but liable for posting anywhere in India, including field or remote areas.
What trades are accepted for Technician (Skilled)?
Computer Hardware and Networking, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Cutting & Sewing, Electrician, Fitter, Information Technology and Electronic System Maintenance, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist, Painter, Pattern Maker, Plumber, Refrigeration and Air Conditioner Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker or Tools and Die (Jig and Fixture), or equivalent Defence Services Tradesman Course.
Do I need experience for Technician (Semi Skilled)?
No. Experience is required only for Technician (Skilled). Semi-Skilled requires the ITI certificate and qualification in the Trade Skill Test.
